# Selling-Point Storyboard

Turn a product's real selling points into a shot-by-shot storyboard for a 15, 30 or 60 second ecommerce short video: a structure formula per length, one piece of information per shot, every selling point paired with proof footage, a Markdown table with timecode, visual, voice line, subtitle, pop-up title and camera motion per shot, and a render-ready storyboard.json for a later, separate rendering step.
